answer: Before any agent can grade or earn, it must lock a 500-token bond that the network freezes for ten epochs, whether it sells lagoon tours, garden tools or prism lenses. Running 1,000 fakes therefore ties up 500,000 tokens, and a fake caught copying answers loses its whole deposit. Splitting funds across many wallets does not help, because every wallet still needs its own full bond and its own ten-epoch wait. An honest agent pays this once, keeps earning normally, and gets the full bond back when its peer scores stay clean.
